sn22.126:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.126:2.1: idha bhikkhu, assutavā puthujjano samudayadhammaṃ rūpaṃ samudayadhammaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.126:2.2: vayadhammaṃ rūpaṃ vayadhammaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.126:2.3: samudayavayadhammaṃ rūpaṃ samudayavayadhammaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.126:2.6: samudayavayadhammaṃ vedanaṃ. samudayavayadhammā vedanāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.126:2.8: samudayadhamme saṅkhāre samudayadhammā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.126:2.11: samudayadhammaṃ viññāṇaṃ samudayadhammaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.126:2.12: vayadhammaṃ viññāṇaṃ vayadhammaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.126:2.13: samudayavayadhammaṃ viññāṇaṃ samudayavayadhammaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.126:3.1: evaṃ vutte so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.126:4.1: idha bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako samudayadhammaṃ rūpaṃ samudayadhammaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.126:4.2: vayadhammaṃ rūpaṃ vayadhammaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.126:4.3: samudayavayadhammaṃ rūpaṃ samudayavayadhammaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.126:4.11: samudayadhammaṃ viññāṇaṃ samudayadhammaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.126:4.12: vayadhammaṃ viññāṇaṃ, vayadhammaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.126:4.13: samudayavayadhammaṃ viññāṇaṃ samudayavayadhammaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
